mapper.select: SELECT c.collection_id, c.account_id, c.name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question q WHERE q.account_id = c.account_id AND q.collection_id = c.collection_id) AS question_count FROM question_collection c WHERE c.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY c.collection_id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM question_collection WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND collection_id = #{collectionId})
